simple.meaning: Gazez , the name of two Israelites
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּזֵז (H1495) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.

simple.summary: גָּזֵז (Gâzêz) means Gazez , the name of two Israelites First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 46.

definitions.short: Gazez , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1495. Gazez גָּזֵז proper name, masculine son of עֵיפָה , concub. of Caleb 1Chr 2:46 (twice in verse); v b says that חָרָן son of עיפה (and Caleb?) begat Gazez. גָּזִית see sub. גזה . above
